title: Eval = today's ATLAS; once funded, + the two stop hunts x0.5
question: ATLAS 2026-10-30 b: can a stage-aware member set (extra members by eval session / room / funded stage) keep the hunts' and the NA lead's money without breaking the 25K eval?
verdict: Passes every numeric gate with the eval unchanged (funded-only); weights 0.4-1.0 all pass; 12 random-time hunt twins pass 0 times. Not an adopt-candidate: the hunts were picked on H1 + 2025 + 2021-24 (only H2 is clean) and most of the H2 gain is sh_trend (audit: not real; needs a limit entry account B cannot place). Paper first. H1: 2-week pass/dead 65.5/0.8, eval-path $1,394/mo less fees, slot $661/mo to the owner net of evals, 4.38 trades/wk; H2: 2-week pass/dead 43.5/0.0, eval-path $547/mo less fees, slot $510/mo to the owner net of evals, 3.27 trades/wk; 2021-25: 2-week pass/dead 24.6/26.2, eval-path $-63/mo less fees, slot $23/mo to the owner net of evals, 5.2 trades/wk. Real-session slot (one path from each span's first session): H1 $866/mo (7 payouts, 3 evals); H2 $1,044/mo (5 payouts, 2 evals); 2025 $70/mo (2 payouts, 6 evals); 2021-24 $33/mo (4 payouts, 27 evals)
notes: tools/atx_edge.py (slot = 300 block-bootstrap paths x 126 sessions, $63 evals, 80% payouts)
